_meta.purpose: Cited provenance for every boundary in config/regions.geojson. Sidecar by design: config/regions.geojson is a LOFRA-sealed artifact and is NEVER edited to carry this metadata, so its byte identity (and every derived mask/state/forecast hash) is preserved. Human narrative lives in docs/region_provenance.md; the machine-checkable `checks` here are enforced by tests/test_region_provenance.py so accidental boundary drift fails CI. The `boundary`/`value`/`label`/`note` strings are the plain-English text rendered on the public Study Regions page — keep them user-facing (no code identifiers or file paths); the `checks` and `source` keys are the machine contract and must not change without moving the geometry.
_meta.doctrine: This is an ESR ecosystem board. The AUTHORITATIVE boundary reference is the AFSC ESR ECOREGIONS, not the fishery-management statistical/survey areas (NMFS 541/542/543). The two systems overlap and disagree by design. Canonical example: the AI Central<->East divide is the ESR ecoregion break at Samalga Pass (~170°W), NOT the management district break at 177°W.
_meta.measured_frame: checks use signed lon in [-180,180) for lon_min/lon_max, lon in [0,360) for lon_min_360/lon_max_360 (dateline-crossing AI), and degrees N for lat_min/lat_max, all read from the polygon vertices.
